notes: Candidate values are design priors, not selected defaults. Pilot coverage and the selection objective must be committed before running the proposed scorer; evaluation scoring waits for a frozen selected configuration.

ablation.interpretation: The full reference plus EMA plus penalties stage is exactly Mstar. No new parameter search occurs for ablations.
ablation.parameters: Use the fully enabled selected candidate's numerical parameters unchanged at every ablation stage

notes: The fixed Sendros mix has two zero, two noise and one stale identity and is run once per seed at its actual fraction five over thirty.
Attack-free training is run once per seed with zero actual attackers; only the other attacks vary over the declared fractions.
Every candidate uses identical cached pilot update matrices. No candidate changes the training aggregator.
All selection candidates enable the excluding reference, EMA and penalties. Component switches are used only in the parameter-matched ablation.
Undefined attacker allocation when nothing is minted incurs unit cost rather than being dropped. Empty rounds and all honest costs are reported separately.
Commit this plan and the scorer before empirical pilot scoring. Commit the selected parameters and corpus digest before evaluation scoring.
pilot_plan.purpose: Select reward parameters only from disjoint pilot training runs

selection.objective: mean attacker share over attack-present cells plus mean honest false-penalty rate over all cells

selection: minimize mean attacker share plus mean honest false-penalty rate among fully enabled candidates; ties prefer lower threshold, longer patience, lower EMA decay
